# INNER CHILD: Playing with Design

## Design exhibition by Lidewij Edelkoort and Philip Fimmano

10 Oct 2026 – 11 Apr 2027

![Bild från utställningen INNER CHILD – Playing with Design, på Artipelag.](https://artipelag.se/app/uploads/2026/05/17.-Installationsvy_InnateArtist-1-2048x1280.webp)

## What happens when we dare to see the world through the curious eyes of a child?

This autumn, Artipelag presents *INNER CHILD: Playing with Design* – a unique exhibition exploring the inner child as a source of creativity, hope, and the joy of making. An international design exhibition about imagination, playfulness, and preserving the child within us.

## Time & Place

The exhibition is on view October 10, 2026 – April 11, 2027.

The Art Gallery will be open until 6 pm on Thursday–Saturday from December 3–19.

**Introduction**  
Get a brief introduction to *INNER CHILD: Playing with Design* and the themes of the exhibition before exploring it on your own.  
*The introduction is included in the admission ticket. Please note that individual introductions may occasionally be cancelled.*

### About the Exhibition

Created exclusively for Artipelag by internationally renowned trend forecaster Lidewij Edelkoort and curator Philip Fimmano, the exhibition brings together the work of one hundred designers and artists in an inspiring narrative about playfulness, imagination, and the human need to create with our hands in an age shaped by rapid technological development and global uncertainty.

Across eight thematic chapters, visitors are invited into a vibrant world of colour, form, and tactile experiences – from sculptural furniture and handcrafted objects to soft textiles and imaginative installations. Together, these works reveal how today’s designers are rediscovering joy, curiosity, and uninhibited imagination as essential driving forces in their creative practice.

The exhibition features some of the most celebrated international designers of our time, including Maarten Baas, Front, Yinka Ilori, Max Lamb, Gustaf Westman, Victoria Yakusha, and Pierre Yovanovitch, alongside many others.

The exhibition design is equally remarkable. It has been created by Dutch designers Kiki van Eijk and Joost van Bleiswijk together with their two children, Ko and Puk. This unique family collaboration permeates the exhibition, reinforcing its playful spirit and imaginative atmosphere.

*INNER CHILD: Playing with Design* is an exhibition that inspires both delight and reflection. It reminds us of the power of imagination, the value of craftsmanship, and the importance of nurturing our curiosity—no matter our age.

On view at Artipelag, 10 October 2026 – 11 April 2027.

### About the Curators

The exhibition at Artipelag is created by **Lidewij Edelkoort** and **Philip Fimmano** – a duo with an international reputation for identifying emerging trends in interiors, fashion and lifestyle.

*INNER CHILD – Playing with Design* is more than an exhibition; it reflects a new movement in design. Edelkoort and Fimmano see a growing desire for playfulness and hope as a response to a present increasingly shaped by seriousness and uncertainty.

### Exhibition Program

In conjunction with *INNER CHILD – Playing with Design*, Artipelag invites you to a program filled with creativity, play, and the joy of making. During the exhibition period, enjoy Afternoon Tea, creative workshops for children and families, and other program events. Come discover, create, and be inspired!
